name: Praxic Blade

perks.name: Balanced Tang
perks.description: A balanced tang for flexing between attack and deflection.

perks.name: Deflection Tang
perks.description: A tang suitable for taking the defensive stance against opponents, favoring deflection.

perks.name: Fencing Tang
perks.description: A tang suitable for taking the offensive stance against opponents favoring attack.

perks.name: Balanced Grip
perks.description: Channel a paracausal grip, balanced between defense and attack.

perks.name: Defensive Grip
perks.description: Channel a paracausal grip on the hilt to bolster defense, maintaining block for longer.

perks.name: Offensive Grip
perks.description: Channel a paracausal grip on the hilt to bolster attack, maintaining your offensive power for longer.

perks.name: Cormorant Reversal
perks.description: While guarding, this Sword converts incoming projectiles into bolts that reflect to where you're aiming.

perks.name: Cormorant Combo
perks.description: After three rapid light melee attacks, quickly [Heavy Attack]  to execute a heavy melee combo.

flavor: A Weapon of Hope, to cut a line between Light and Dark.

catalyst.name: Echoing Blade
catalyst.description: Increases the number of targets that the thrown Sword can hit.
